###############################################################################
# Hierarchical Clustering Workflow: Multi-Attribute Spatial Data
###############################################################################
```{r}
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(dendextend)
library(data.table)
```
```{r}
# Load synthetic census-tract socio-economic dataset
set.seed(713)
n_tracts <- 150
spatial_socioeco <- data.table(
  tract_id = paste0("TRACT_", 1000 + 1:n_tracts),
  med_income = rnorm(n_tracts, mean = 65000, sd = 15000),
  pct_college = runif(n_tracts, 10, 65),
  housing_density = rweibull(n_tracts, shape = 2, scale = 1200),
  transit_score = rbeta(n_tracts, 2, 5) * 100
)
```


```{r}
# Extract feature matrix and scale attributes
# pulling everything except for the tract id out of the spatial data frame 
feature_matrix <- as.matrix(spatial_socioeco[, .(med_income, pct_college, housing_density, transit_score)])
rownames(feature_matrix) <- spatial_socioeco$tract_id
scaled_features <- scale(feature_matrix)
```

```{r}
# 1. Compute Pairwise Euclidean Dissimilarity Matrix
# compute distances on the scaled features
dist_euclidean <- dist(scaled_features, method = "euclidean")
diag(dist_euclidean)
```

```{r}
# 2. Evaluate Agglomerative Coefficients across Linkage Methods
# Agnes is the agglomerative clustering 
linkage_methods <- c("single", "complete", "average", "ward")
ac_results <- sapply(linkage_methods, function(m) {
  agnes(scaled_features, method = m)$ac
})
print("Agglomerative Coefficients across Linkage Algorithms:")
print(ac_results)
# The agglomerative coefficient tells us how well things are clustered together 
```

```{r}
# 3. Fit AGNES with Ward's Method and DIANA Divisive Clustering
hc_ward <- agnes(scaled_features, method = "ward")
hc_divisive <- diana(scaled_features)
```

```{r}
# 4. Tanglegram Comparison between Complete Linkage and Ward's Method
dend_complete <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist_euclidean, method = "complete"))
dend_ward <- as.dendrogram(as.hclust(hc_ward))
```

```{r}
# Compute Entanglement
entang_val <- entanglement(dend_complete, dend_ward)
cat("Dendrogram Entanglement (Complete vs. Ward):", round(entang_val, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Plot Tanglegram
tanglegram(
  untangle(dend_complete, dend_ward),
  main_left = "Complete Linkage",
  main_right = "Ward's Method",
  highlight_distinct_edges = TRUE,
  common_subtrees_color_lines = TRUE,
  lwd = 1.2
)
```
```{r}
# 5. Optimal Cluster Selection via Silhouette and Gap Statistic
p1 <- fviz_nbclust(scaled_features, FUN = hcut, method = "silhouette") +
  labs(title = "Optimal k: Average Silhouette Width")
print(p1)
```

```{r}
# Cluster gaps
gap_stat <- clusGap(scaled_features, FUN = hcut, nstart = 25, K.max = 10, B = 50)
p2 <- fviz_gap_stat(gap_stat) +
  labs(title = "Optimal k: Monte Carlo Gap Statistic")
print(p2)
```

```{r}
# Cut Tree at k = 4 and Visualize Spatial Profiles
cluster_assignments <- cutree(as.hclust(hc_ward), k = 4)
spatial_socioeco[, cluster_ward := cluster_assignments]

fviz_cluster(
  list(data = scaled_features, cluster = cluster_assignments),
  ellipse.type = "convex",
  repel = TRUE,
  show.clust.cent = TRUE,
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
  main = "Multi-Attribute Spatial Census Clusters (Ward's AGNES)"
)
```
